ADD `--mode {play,commands}` (default `play`, current behaviour unchanged). `commands` is 'Live A: isolated recorded-command probes': NO player model is called (zero raw_player spend; refuse to run if --start is not post8). For each rep (1..n) and each arm (control, pre667, interleaved) and each of the six recorded raw commands of 3C turns 9 to 14, build a FRESH post8 state (scripted prefix as now, zero provider calls), swap in the real provider (semantic per --semantic), run exactly ONE engine.turn(command), and record one probe row: arm, rep, turn_label (9..14), command, status (accepted/rejected/clarification as run_row derives), committed_reveals, d_r1_committed (bool), rejection text, response text, story-fact delta, request_count. Turns are never chained: every probe starts from a fresh post8 state.

CAPS: --n is reps per arm. Cloudflare cap = 3 * (probes) (n=1: 36, n=12: 432); raw_player cap 0. SpendBudget enforces it; any cap/quota/malformed error stops, writes run-failure.txt verbatim, no retry or replacement. rows.json is written incrementally. summary.json: per arm and per turn_label, counts of d_r1_committed, accepted, rejected, clarification; plus per-arm totals; no significance claims. plan.json (dry and live) lists the probe order, caps, `start_label`, `mode`, and per-arm universe ids ([k_sl_3c_d_r1] exactly: keep the preflight, run it per probe state). check_three_c_probe.py must accept plan.json `mode: commands` and verify: 12*n*... correct probe count (6 per arm per rep, 2 arms), interleaving, caps, zero raw_player events, every row has a status, summary counts reconcile with rows, and print WHY on failure.

HERMETIC TESTS (real RuntimeEngine, fake provider, no network): (1) in commands mode exactly 12 probes per rep are generated and each starts from a fresh state (a prior probe's committed reveals do not leak into the next); (2) a fake provider that returns the d_r1 delivery text with grounding_ids for the turn-13 command ('Continue broadcasting the reports from all remaining detention sites and coordinate their rescue.') yields d_r1_committed True in the control arm; and in the pre667 arm the same command is NOT matched by the live matcher (assert via the projector/uniquely_matched_authored_handoff that the exact handoff is None for pre667 and d_r1 for control), without relying on the fake provider's selection; (3) commands mode makes zero raw_player ask() calls; (4) commands mode with --start entry is refused. Finish: pytest on test_three_c_probe.py, ruff format + check on the three files, `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py --n 1 --mode commands --start post8 --semantic on --dry-run --out /tmp/3c-cmd-dry` and `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/stage7/check_three_c_probe.py /tmp/3c-cmd-dry 1 --mode dry`; and confirm `--n 1 --dry-run --start post8` (play mode) still passes its check.
